decisions.append: Accept T01 exact-descriptor-and-bytes duplicate idempotence for explicitly allowed live states with retained verifiable bytes. No rewrite, second advance, extra pin or lifetime extension. Supersedes earlier I06 reject-all-duplicate candidate; historical fixed files unchanged.
decisions.terminalAppend: After cleanup return authoritative terminal status/rejection, never pretend bytes can still be compared. Accepted Job/pin cannot be revoked by a late conflicting append or release. Drop stale ordinal/context ACKs; do not roll progress backwards.
decisions.budgets: Controller technically adopts 1 pending begin, 2 unadmitted leases/16MiB raw, 30 idle/120 total/600 sealed seconds, 256 attempts and 256MiB logical encoded source. Conservative design budgets, not Q5, measured capacity, RSS or physical disk. Accounting/barrier/cleanup and finite canonical states still required.
decisions.claim: Separate stable plan from transient AdmissionProof. No-admit expired/revoked/session-changed input requires new preview/source proof/human confirmation. Unknown original operation requires barrier/fence reconciliation before any new operation. Existing claim authenticates current project read access and original complete context, then returns original receipt without requiring old lease live or current CAS again.
decisions.table: Controller routed fixed T03 complete projection data to T01; not a runtime parser dependency or frozen tableDigest schema.
decisions.t10: Accepts guard boundary; PreparedHtmlReportFile still requires later real IO capability adaptation. This registered metadata core provides none.
